methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: A typical Estonian apartment building (Fig. 1) was selected as a reference building

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus on residential apartment-building renovation with no industrial component. "EnPI" appears only as a building energy-intensity indicator kWh/(m2a) output by IDA-ICE dynamic simulation and used as a comparison axis; the paper presents no EnPI/EnB measurement model (no energy baseline, normalisation-variable model, or SEC/regression fit). Framing is EPBD / LCA, not ISO 50001/50006 energy management. Falls under the registered 'residential buildings without industrial component' exclusion.

paper_type.evidence_quote: It is a three-story apartment building comprising of 24 apartments.

stage1.notes: Residential apartment-building renovation study comparing cost-optimal, CO2e-optimal and total-energy-optimal solutions via LCA and IDA-ICE simulation. Uses EnPI = energy intensity kWh/(m2a) as a comparison axis but constructs no EnPI/EnB measurement model; no ISO 50001/50006 framing (EPBD/LCA only). Ineligible via residential-buildings exclusion. Borderline: an EnPI is explicitly defined.
